title: Low-temperature methanol-assisted CO2 hydrogenation populates intermediates over a Ce-promoted Cu/ZnO/MgO catalyst in a three-phase slurry reactor
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00694E, Communication
Vaibhav Pandey, Priyanshu Pratap Singh, Aakash Bhardwaj, Kamal Kishore Pant, Sreedevi Upadhyayula, Siddhartha Sengupta
Novel methanol-assisted CO2 hydrogenation produces methanol with high yield at 150 °C over a Ce-promoted Cu–MgO–ZnO catalyst, unveiling a new low-temperature reaction pathway.
